guitar.evidence: Dio's guitarists (Vivian Campbell on Holy Diver/Last in Line era, later Craig Goldy) commonly used Jackson/Charvel-style superstrats typical of early-80s metal, but no single guitar is iconic enough for higher confidence.

tone.target: bright 80s hard-rock crunch with sustained lead and subtle chorus
tone.profile: bright 80s hard-rock crunch with sustained lead and subtle chorus
tone.summary: A classic 80s hard rock chain utilizing a Plexi-style amp model, boosted by an OD pedal for crunch, followed by Chorus for sheen, and finished with a bright cabinet simulation.

rig.name: Dio - Rainbow In The Dark - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up high-gain passages and tight palm-muting.
Provide the necessary mid-forward crunch and bite for 80s hard rock rhythm.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is a general choice; an actual Plexi/JCM style boost would be ideal, but this provides the required grit.

blocks.purpose: Add the required '80s chorus sheen' for sustained leads without sounding overly wet.
Used as a secondary boost/grit layer for lead sustain (optional bypass).
blocks.gap: The Green OD handles the primary crunch; this is an optional grit enhancer.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the bright, mid-focused tone of a Plexi/JCM style amp head.
blocks.gap: The UK SLP is a good proxy for British rock tones; specific JCM models are absent.

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic British rock cabinet sound and necessary upper-mid bite.
Boost the upper-mids and treble to achieve 'upper-mid bite' and cut through the mix.
Add subtle sustain and depth without sounding like heavy delay.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for increased upper-mid bite and vintage Plexi character.

proposals.reason: Enhance the classic British hard rock upper-mid bite and tone consistency.
